explication: Foundry is a Rust toolkit for Ethereum development, centered on Forge, Cast, Anvil, and Chisel. A developer can build and test Solidity projects with Forge, inspect or interact with chains using Cast, run a local node with Anvil, and experiment interactively in Chisel. Shared EVM execution, compilation, configuration, and trace facilities support those workflows. The README documents the major product capabilities; the tree supports subsystem placement, but unsampled implementation details do not establish additional call relationships.
